## Analysis

Sol_0029 is the first improvement since sol_0023 and validates affine composition after five failed local-neighborhood searches. Its jump to 473 elements shows that beneficial cross-copy collisions survive near the size cap; however, the deletion annealing found only a small gain, suggesting copy geometry—not pointwise membership—is the productive variable. Two-copy composition is therefore promising, while local sparsification and coordinate perturbation remain effectively refuted. The remaining 39 slots may admit a highly overlapping third copy that improves cross-copy sum coverage without proportionally increasing differences.
